description: The database forces TLS (rds.force_ssl = 1), authenticates by IAM, encrypts storage, and keeps automated backups at least the declared 7 days

matrix_rows.gap: IAM authentication is read from RDS; that password authentication is disabled for the application user is a database role attribute, which this does not connect to read.
The database's automated backup retention, judged while phase 1 stands; object versioning on the stores is checked elsewhere (state bucket, Object Lock) and not joined to the declared windows here.
